question: Q2 compute-only recognized revenue after storage, networking and software; exact active-power metering boundary; dated IT-MW activations; physical utilization; matched facility/IT energy and IT-energy weights remain undisclosed. Without them, neither chips per MW nor revenue per effective utilized IT MW is supportable.

The recent approximately $40M/MW-year contract cohort lacks customer identities, MW, cluster architecture, IT-versus-facility power definition, utilization, margin, prepayment amount, renewal/termination terms and delivery acceptance schedule; the 3-6 month duration creates unquantified rollover risk.

Site-specific lease construction cost, rent commencement, utility delivery, PPA/offtake, remedies, VIE/SPV debt, guarantees, customer matching and residual-value waterfalls are not disclosed for the 393MW and 355MW undelivered cohorts.

No comparable realized token/task price-decline series, task-volume growth, quality mix or open-versus-proprietary workload split is disclosed. July's price increase and reported effective-training-time metrics do not supply an exact Jevons break-even test.
